title: ChatGPT now lets you lock your chats

sources.summary: The company says the feature is designed for situations where users might be discussing something personal or planning a surprise and want to keep those conversations private when handing their device to friends or family to show them something in another chat.

title: Eric Schmidt reportedly owns about half as much of Anthropic as CEO Dario Amodei

sources.summary: The former Google CEO owns about 1% stake in the leading AI lab, Bloomberg reported.

title: Meta’s Muse hits 10M U.S. downloads in 40 days, a milestone reached by only 11 other apps

sources.summary: Meta's AI companion Muse has surpassed 10 million U.S. downloads in its first 40 days, joining an exclusive group of apps that includes Threads. New data also shows Muse is retaining users at higher rates than its AI rivals.

title: Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in it’s LEGO era’

sources.summary: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.

title: Streaming guide JustWatch becomes a streamer itself

sources.summary: JustWatch, the popular streaming search guide used by 50 million people, is launching its own streaming service, offering free, ad-supported movies and shows alongside a $3.99-per-month ad-free tier and movie rentals.

title: Plants can speak using electricity, so this startup built an AI model to decipher their language

sources.summary: Electric Plant has built an AI-powered translator to help humans listen to what plants are saying with the subtle electricity coursing through their stems.

title: TikTok staff raised child safety concerns, but executives reportedly failed to act

sources.summary: Court documents show TikTok employees were frustrated with how executives responded to their concerns about risks to children.

title: Figma co-founder Dylan Field thinks MCP is not a perfect protocol

sources.summary: Figma said it plans to support as many standards as possible without exposing all of its data.

title: SpaceX alum’s aviation startup, Reliable Robotics, lands $115M, topping $1B valuation

sources.summary: Reliable Robotics extended its Series D round with $115 million in equity and $25 million in debt.

title: US orders federal agencies to remove China’s DeepSeek AI from their systems

sources.summary: The US has ordered federal civilian agencies to remove DeepSeek products and third-party services built using its technology, citing national security concerns.

title: Eka is worth $1.45B thanks to a physical AI model that has experts raving

sources.summary: Eka Robotics may be the first robotic arm that is actually good at picking a wide range of objects up, and it is so smooth and human-like, it is wowing the industry.

title: Inspired Capital closes $450M fourth fund as New York pushes back on Silicon Valley’s gravitational pull

sources.summary: The raise comes as venture dollars pile up on the West Coast.

title: Spotify launches paid podcast memberships with perks beyond bonus content

sources.summary: Spotify's new paid memberships let podcasters offer fans exclusive perks, including ad-free listening, early access, and bonus content, while keeping 90% of the revenue.

title: Oura adds new fitness metrics to show how workouts impact your body

sources.summary: While Oura has largely dominated the smart ring market for years, rivals like RingConn and Ultrahuman are emerging to dethrone it, putting pressure on the company to keep innovating. By launching more advanced workout metrics, Oura is looking to differentiate itself from competitors as the smart ring market gets more crowded.

title: Yelp can now call on your behalf to check wait times at a restaurant

sources.summary: Yelp is embedding numerous new AI features into its app that can do everything from call to check on restaurant wait times to create personalized recommendations that remember your preferences.
